subject: general
question: What will be the area of a parallelogram with base 44 cm and height 22 cm?
solution:
Given:

Base = 44 cm 

Height = 22 cm

Concept used:

Area of a parallelogram = Base × Height

Calculation:

The area of the parallelogram = 44 × 22 = 968 cm²

∴ The area of the parallelogram will be 968 cm².
